whatsNew:
Speed

Opening a chat was waiting on the whole app to reload before it would show a single message. It now asks for that chat and nothing else, and the reload behind it does about a quarter of the work it used to. Sending settles the same way.

Your chat list

A chat with a new message moves to the top where it belongs, under any favourites. It was sorted by something that never changed when a message arrived, so a conversation from an hour ago could sit below one nobody had touched in days.

Also fixed

- Sending in a group no longer scrolls somewhere else and comes back.
- Searching your chats by two people finds the group holding them both. This only worked by luck before.
- A chat with history no longer says "No messages yet" while it loads.

Please check

- Open a few chats, especially ones you have not opened in a while.
- Send in a group and watch the thread.
- Have someone message you and watch the chat list reorder.
- Search your chats for two people who share a group.
whatsNewPlay:
